summary: Admin Moderation queues paginate server-side with optional search filter. Moderation action routes and authz are unchanged.
detailed_changes: Paginate profiles, comments, reports, and suspended queues (15 per page) with named page query params.
Optional q search filters display names, bios, comment bodies, report reasons, and related user names.
Inertia payload includes counts, filters, and prev/next links; UI search form added.
